text:
alex.seller: Quick heads-up — Tara (ACME Fin) asked if Redwood can run a FIPS 140-2 backed BYO-HSM POC that includes an offline key ceremony and hourly ephemeral key rotation. They also want a short note on cost impact (high QPS worry). Need answers for presales + legal by EOD.

mira.solutions: We can support FIPS-certified HSMs via our BYO-HSM path (CloudHSM or on-prem HSM proxy). Offline ceremony is doable — customer supplies sealed key material and we run the import flow on the private plane. Need crypto ops to confirm the hourly rotation detail.

mira.solutions: Main tradeoffs to call out: hourly ephemeral keys != CMK rotation. We can derive short-lived session keys from a CMK so the long-lived key stays stable while sessions rotate.

mira.solutions: Will write a quick POC runbook after crypto confirms.

mira.solutions: @jon.crypto can you confirm the minimum rotation window and whether we need any infra changes for 1h TTLs?

jon.crypto: Short answer — yes, we support derived ephemeral keys with 1h TTL. Implementation notes: we keep the customer CMK in the HSM (FIPS) and derive ephemeral KEKs out-of-band; those KEKs can be rotated hourly without re-importing the CMK. No HSM re-provision required for each rotation.

jon.crypto: Example config snippet we use in POCs (high-level):
```
rotation:
  mode: ephemeral-derived
  base_key: customer-cmk-id
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  ceremony: offline-import
```

jon.crypto: CLI example to kick off a rotation cycle during POC: `redwood keys rotate --cmk <cmk-id> --mode ephemeral-derived --ttl 3600`

jon.crypto: Caveat — audit events will spike because each derived key rotation emits an audit entry. Audit retention is configurable but you should expect more log volume.

emily.legal: From compliance side: we can provide the FIPS attestation and an audit log export for 12 months (can extend as an add-on). Offline ceremony documentation + signed import manifest is required for our compliance records. Also need to confirm key escrow and access controls in the SOW.

emily.legal: For the POC legal team will accept the standard POC NDA + an addendum stating the customer-managed key responsibilities.

alex.seller: Tara — price note up front: the hourly rotations themselves do not create per-token generation charges, but they do increase API calls and audit log volume which can affect billables (log retention addon, egress, and potentially Dedicated capacity needs if QPS spikes).

alex.seller: If you expect sustained high QPS during the POC we recommend a short Dedicated pool trial (reserved for the POC week) so you don't hit throttles and we can give a predictable cost estimate.

tara.customer-cto: Appreciate the quick answers. Two asks: 1) can you confirm the expected audit log delta for an example QPS (say 500 qps) — ballpark numbers fine; 2) is there a pricing diff for CloudHSM vs on-prem HSM for BYO?

jon.crypto: For 500 QPS with hourly ephemeral rotation: expect ~500 extra audit events/sec (one per key usage) plus 1 rotation event per tenant per hour. Ballpark log growth: ~1.8GB/day extra if you keep verbose events (depends on JSON payload size). We can switch to compact events to drop it ~3x.

mira.solutions: Pricing: CloudHSM BYO — you'll pay standard BYO integration + hourly HSM costs (cloud vendor). On-prem: there's an integration fee and managed import runbook. We'll provide a line-item in the POC quote for either path. Dedicated capacity price will be separate.

mira.solutions: I'll draft a one-page POC sketch (scope + checklist + cost knobs) and drop it here in 90m.

deploy-bot: POC environment provisioned: rwd-poc-acme-01 (private plane) — credentials sent to alex.seller DM.

alex.seller: Next steps: 1) Mira to post POC sketch; 2) Jon to attach rotation implementation notes + audit-size calc; 3) Emily to add POC legal addendum snippet.

alex.seller: I'll schedule a 30m runbook call — https://cal.example.com/redwood/poc-runbook/tara (tentative for tomorrow 10am PT).

tara.customer-cto: OK thanks — that timeline works. Will prep the import manifest and legal contact. :thumbsup:

mira.solutions: Noted, will post docs here when ready. :rocket:
